---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to the software, examples, or project documentation.
title: "[Feature]: "
---

## Is your request about software or theory?

Briefly indicate whether this is a package/API, example, documentation, or
scientific-framework request.

## What problem would this solve?

Describe the use case or limitation you encountered.

## What would you like to happen?

Describe the behavior or outcome you have in mind. For a theory-related
request, state the assumptions involved and how the proposal could be
checked or falsified.

## Alternatives or context

Mention any alternatives considered, relevant references, or related issues.

## Additional details

Include example inputs, outputs, or sketches if they would help explain the
request. State units and reference scales for physical quantities.
